decoder.construction: pymatching.Matching.from_detector_error_model on the placement's own Stim DEM, built with approximate_disjoint_errors=True, decompose_errors=True, ignore_decomposition_failures=True; decode_batch on detection events
decoder.reason: K1: Nove's Experiment.to_detector_model() raises for calibrated two-qubit Pauli channels with more than one non-zero term, so no exact DEM exists; Stim's approximate_disjoint_errors model is used instead.

methods.decoder-graph: Leading-order logical failure probability of a minimum-weight matching decoder, from the decomposed approximate detector error model of the placed circuit: undetectable logical errors plus, for every minimum-length closed path through the boundary that flips a logical observable, the probability that the errors on it outweigh half the path.
methods.lowest-summed-error: Sum over every gate, measurement and reset operation of the placed circuit of its total error probability (Pauli channel total, readout flip or reset flip); idle noise excluded.
methods.qiskit-vf2: Qiskit VF2Layout on an op-for-op Qiskit circuit and a Target whose instruction errors are the Nove channels' total error probabilities; settings {'seed': -1, 'strict_direction': True, 'call_limit': None, 'max_trials': None, 'time_limit': None}
methods.v1: Total probability of fault mechanisms in Stim's approximate detector error model (approximate_disjoint_errors=True) of the relabelled circuit lowered with the Nove hardware noise model: the expected number of detector-visible faults per shot.
